definitions.gloss: shelf life, keeping quality, how well something keeps
definitions.explanation: How long food or other perishable items remain fresh or usable. Describes the ability of a product to stay in good condition over time.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦お{菓子|かし}→お菓子：02852_okashi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日持|ひも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{生|なま}クリーム→生クリーム：15884_namakuriimu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{日持|ひも}ち⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Fresh cream cake doesn't keep long.

examples.japanese: ⟦お{土産|みやげ}→お土産：01353_omiyage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{日持|ひも}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ものにした⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: When choosing souvenirs, it's better to pick things that keep well.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly used in the patterns {日持|ひも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (keeps well) and {日持|ひも}ち⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧ (doesn't keep well). Very practical everyday vocabulary, especially when discussing food gifts, souvenirs, and cooking. An important consideration in Japanese gift-giving culture, where {日持|ひも}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧もの (long-lasting items) are preferred for souvenirs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日持|ひも}ち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to keep well, to have a long shelf life
- {日持|ひも}ち⟦しない→する：00392_suru⟧: doesn't keep, perishable
- {日持|ひも}ち⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧: food with a long shelf life
